sections.path: C:\Users\klimp\OneDrive\Documents\Paradox Interactive\Hearts of Iron IV\mod\chaos_redux\paradox_wiki\Entity modding - Hearts of Iron 4 Wiki.md
sections.excerpt: - **event** is a scope that applies a particle or sound effect. - **animation** is the animation state (from the pdxmesh) to play. - **animation_blend_time** is the blend time between the current and the specified animation.

sections.title: Entity modding
sections.heading: Adding an Entity
sections.path: C:\Users\klimp\OneDrive\Documents\Paradox Interactive\Hearts of Iron IV\mod\chaos_redux\paradox_wiki\Entity modding - Hearts of Iron 4 Wiki.md
sections.excerpt: - **default_state** is the default animation state for the entity. - **get_state_from_parent** inherits the state of the parent entity (i.e. used by the weapon entity that is part of a soldier). - **attach** is a scope that attachs another entity to a skeleton node of the current entity.
